name: common-test-37d14c64be/operand-option-rest-param-v.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

## Invocations / ### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The signature is supported, but this case essentially tests command-line argument binding, which subset10 does not cover. Its @args requires --name Riyafa to populate an included record field, --good to become boolean true without consuming the following operand, 100 to bind score, and remaining operands 5 and 3 to become the int rest array. Function signature and function-call argument support do not specify this command-line behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line option and operand parsing into required, included-record and rest parameters of main, including a valueless boolean option
test_design_notes: The assertions require student.name == Riyafa, student.good == true, score == 100, and ratings == [5, 3] under the supplied @args.
ballerina/test is not excluded by the restriction on ballerina/lang.* libraries; the decisive gap is command-line binding.
